response.sql: WITH tel_avg AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pps FROM signals WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL GROUP BY telescref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) AS overall_avg FROM signals WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL), kept1 AS (SELECT t.telescref, t.avg_pps FROM tel_avg t, overall o WHERE t.avg_pps > o.overall_avg), second AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pps) AS second_avg FROM kept1), kept2 AS (SELECT k.avg_pps FROM kept1 k, second s WHERE k.avg_pps > s.second_avg) SELECT AVG(k.avg_pps) AS mean_avg_pulse_rate, AVG(k.avg_pps - o.overall_avg) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(k.avg_pps - s.second_avg) AS avg_above_second FROM kept2 k, overall o, second s;
